cards.title: Functions use other tools
cards.body: Inside a function you can use any built-in tool: `split()`, `len()`, `max()` and the rest.

hi.title: Functions doosre tools use karte hain
hi.body: Function ke andar aap koi bhi built-in tool use kar sakte ho: `split()`, `len()`, `max()` aur baaki sab.

cards.title: len() works on lists
cards.body: `len()` counts the items in a list, so you can count the pieces after splitting. `split(",")` cuts at commas instead of spaces.

hi.title: len() lists par chalta hai
hi.body: `len()` list ke items ginta hai, isliye split karne ke baad tukde gin sakte ho. `split(",")` spaces ki jagah commas par kaatta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should count the drinks and print 3, but prints 1. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: `split()` cuts at spaces, and there are none here. Cut at the commas: `line.split(",")`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse drinks gin kar 3 print karna chahiye, par yeh 1 print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `split()` spaces par kaatta hai, aur yahan koi space hai hi nahi. Commas par kaato: `line.split(",")`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: split() gives 4 words, and len() counts them.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: split() 4 words deta hai, aur len() unhe ginta hai.
